hypothesis: Distant heroes chase a failing observed outer-tower alarm and arrive after its target changes. Rallying behind the nearest surviving inward structure, only when at least 48 Manhattan tiles from the current anchor and the new anchor saves at least 16 tiles, should create earlier useful interception. Keep actual threatened anchor, alarm criteria, target ranking, dense recovery, hold/release rules and purchases intact. Test all roles and existing sentry roles as two separate scopes; no opponent labels, seed or private state.

screen.decision_rule: Require all complete native audits, gear for every subject, cellwise fort-win nonregression versus accepted parent AND deployed suppression on both colors against seven explicit policies, >=60% each color against accepted parent, total deaths <=max(1.25*parent,parent+5) and <=max(1.15*suppression,suppression+5). Require changed inward rally observed in a complete reacting game. Select at most one qualifying source by total wins, deaths, then source name. Equal fort counts allow larger fresh local confirmation only if mechanism activates; no inherited-win improvement claim.

confirmation.decision_rule: Fresh matched confirmation with four cases per rival/color retains screen audit/equipment/cell/death/self-win criteria and observed mechanism. Hosted exploration allowed only if all criteria pass; no generalization claim.

stress.decision_rule: If confirmation passes, central owned rosters both colors; no parent/suppression lost fort wins per cell and same survival limits. At least one complete win and failure/draw reviewed where available.

hosted: Any next discovery starts exactJordan268 both colors with fresh accepted-parent AND deployed-suppression controls. Prospective field preservation includes g002, black16, macro4, relh154 and Jordan254 plus newer threats; fresh XP only via controller, plan spans cycles if needed. No holdout before freeze.
known_failures: Prior broad alarm/quiet release and nonhero handoff failures remain closed. Initial remote response also appears in suppression wins, so this is a falsifiable mechanism, not an established cause of loss.
